canonical_example.text: ¿Qué resultados pretendes encontrar con esta investigación?
canonical_example.translation: What results do you intend to find with this investigation?

canonical_example.translation: You cannot claim that there is no wage inequality between men and women.

canonical_example.translation: In my culture, men still woo women with bouquets of roses.

canonical_example.translation: I'm running the marathon this year.

canonical_example.translation: Don't run unnecessary risks. Put yourself in the hands of a professional.

canonical_example.translation: Tell Esteban to shift up so that Ines can sit down.

canonical_example.translation: My uncle served in the army during World War I.

canonical_example.translation: I was absorbed by the book and I couldn't stop reading it.

canonical_example.translation: The secret to making the perfect roast beef is good seasoning and a hot oven.

canonical_example.translation: Every Sunday, my grandmother prepares a roast with mashed potatoes.

canonical_example.translation: We're doing a barbecue at home next Friday to celebrate my cousin's birthday.

canonical_example.text: Me gusta mucho cómo le sale cuando asa la carne mi tío.
canonical_example.translation: I really like how my uncle's meat turns out when he grills it.

canonical_example.translation: After waiting in line under the scorching sun for two hours, I was roasting.

canonical_example.text: Creo en un ser superior.

canonical_example.text: Creo que podría estar enfermo.

canonical_example.translation: They have established a committee to investigate government corruption.

canonical_example.text: No me creo mejor que tú.
canonical_example.translation: I don't believe that I am better than you.

canonical_example.text: ¿Te crees tan guapo?
canonical_example.translation: You think you're so good-looking?

canonical_example.text: ¿Pero tú piensas que se lo cree en serio?
canonical_example.translation: Do you think she really believes that?

canonical_example.text: Tus acciones han creado mucha agitación.

canonical_example.text: Creó un robot que hace licuados.

canonical_example.text: Has creado muchos problemas para tu pobre mamá.
canonical_example.translation: You've caused your poor mother a lot of trouble.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro jefe creó esta empresa junto con su hermano.
canonical_example.translation: Our boss founded this company with his brother.

canonical_example.text: Antes de crear la compañía, tienen que conseguir un préstamo.
canonical_example.translation: Before setting up the company, you have to get a loan.

canonical_example.text: Los mozos del pueblo se reunieron en la plaza para jugar un partido de fútbol.
canonical_example.translation: The young boys of the village gathered in the square to play a game of soccer.

canonical_example.text: En las fiestas, me envalentoné y le pedí un baile a una moza que me gustaba.
canonical_example.translation: At the festival, I plucked up the courage to ask a young girl I liked to dance.

canonical_example.text: Te recomiendo ese restaurante; la comida es buena y los mozos muy agradables.
canonical_example.translation: I highly recommend that restaurant. The food is good and the waiters are very pleasant.

canonical_example.text: Una vez en la estación, le pedí a un mozo que me llevara el equipaje a un taxi.
canonical_example.translation: When I arrived at the station, I asked a porter to take my luggage to a cab.

canonical_example.text: Yo en mis años mozos no me hubiera perdido una fiesta por nada en el mundo.
canonical_example.translation: I wouldn't have missed a party for anything in the world in my youth.

canonical_example.text: La moza nos tomó nota de las bebidas, pero no de la comida.
canonical_example.translation: The waitress took our drink orders, but not our food orders.

canonical_example.text: No todos los mozos del reemplazo eran declarados aptos para el servicio militar.
canonical_example.translation: Not all draft conscripts were declared suitable for military service.

canonical_example.text: El monstruo, vencido, se precipitó al abismo.
canonical_example.translation: The monster, vanquished, plunged into the abyss.

canonical_example.text: Miró hacia abajo, pero no podía ver el fondo del abismo.
canonical_example.translation: He looked down, but he couldn't see the bottom of the chasm.

canonical_example.text: Vivíamos con gran intensidad, pero siempre con la sensación de estar al borde del abismo.
canonical_example.translation: We lived very intensely, but always with the feeling of being on the edge of the abyss.

canonical_example.text: Tras su infidelidad, se había abierto un abismo entre ellos.
canonical_example.translation: After her infidelity, an abyss had opened between them.

canonical_example.text: A mi parecer, entre ambas ideologías existe un abismo.
canonical_example.translation: In my opinion, there is a big gulf between the two ideologies.

canonical_example.text: No compares. Entre su vida y la nuestra hay un abismo.
canonical_example.translation: You can't compare. Between their life and ours there's a world of difference.

canonical_example.text: No conseguía salir del abismo en el que se había sumido tras la muerte de su marido.
canonical_example.translation: She couldn't drag herself from the depths she had plunged into after her husband's death.

canonical_example.text: Es Lucifer quien reina en el abismo.
canonical_example.translation: It is Lucifer who reigns in hell.

canonical_example.text: La muerte de su esposo la abismó por un largo tiempo.
canonical_example.translation: Her husband's death plunged her into despair for a long time.

canonical_example.text: Después del accidente, Pedro se abismó en una depresión que nunca superó.
canonical_example.translation: After the accident, Pedro plunged into a depression that he could never overcome.

canonical_example.text: Él está pagando la cuenta.
canonical_example.translation: He is paying the bill.

canonical_example.text: Mi primo me pagó el almuerzo.

canonical_example.text: Me las pagarás por lo que me hiciste.
canonical_example.translation: You're going to pay for what you did to me.

canonical_example.translation: I already paid.

canonical_example.text: Yo acabo de pagar mis deudas de la universidad.
canonical_example.translation: I just paid off my college loans.

canonical_example.text: Toma cinco años pagar el préstamo del carro.
canonical_example.translation: It takes five years to repay the loan on the car.

canonical_example.translation: I had to bake two hundred cupcakes for the school party.

canonical_example.translation: Next year we will celebrate the two hundredth anniversary of the founding of my city.

canonical_example.text: Dos por cien es doscientos.
canonical_example.translation: Two times a hundred is two hundred.

canonical_example.text: Ella insiste en trabajar aunque esté enferma.
canonical_example.translation: She insists on going to work even when she's sick.

canonical_example.text: No insistas con la misma queja de siempre.
canonical_example.translation: Don't go on about that same old complaint.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuelo solía beberse un vaso de coñac después de cenar.
canonical_example.translation: My grandfather used to drink a glass of brandy after dinner.

canonical_example.text: El coñac procede de las uvas blancas.
canonical_example.translation: Cognac is made from white grapes.

canonical_example.text: Al final de la guerra liberaron a todos los prisioneros.
canonical_example.translation: All prisoners were freed at the end of the war.

canonical_example.text: Los terroristas liberaron a los rehenes tras el pago del rescate.
canonical_example.translation: The terrorists released the hostages after the ransom was paid.

canonical_example.text: La energía liberada por el sol no se mantiene siempre constante.
canonical_example.translation: The energy released by the sun is not always the same.

canonical_example.text: Esas mujeres hicieron lo imposible por liberarse de los condicionamientos sociales.
canonical_example.translation: Those women did everything they could to liberate themselves from social conditioning.

canonical_example.text: Liberé a un perro de una trampa para zorros.

canonical_example.text: Eso no les libera de los compromisos adquiridos.
canonical_example.translation: That doesn't free them from the commitments they have undertaken.

canonical_example.text: Las partes pueden ser liberadas de su obligación de confidencialidad por mandato judicial.
canonical_example.translation: The parties can be released from the obligation of confidentiality by court order.

canonical_example.text: En dichos casos el inquilino queda liberado del pago.
canonical_example.translation: In such cases, the tenant is exempted from the payment.

canonical_example.text: El gobierno se propone liberar gradualmente los precios del combustible.
canonical_example.translation: The government's aim is to gradually deregulate fuel prices.

canonical_example.text: Solo se pueden liberar las acciones cuyo valor esté totalmente cubierto.
canonical_example.translation: Only shares whose full value is covered can be released.

canonical_example.text: Liberar la divisa podría llevar a una fuerte devaluación de la misma.
canonical_example.translation: Floating the currency might lead to its sharp devaluation.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuánto cobran ustedes por liberar un celular?
canonical_example.translation: How much do you charge to unlock a cell phone?

canonical_example.text: Para poner fin a la discriminación, tendríamos antes que liberarnos de nuestros prejuicios.
canonical_example.translation: In order to put an end to discrimination, we'd first have to rid ourselves of our prejudices.
